text:
emily-support: FYI customer ACME hit a reproducible case where SSE stops mid-response when switching WiFi -> cellular. Client shows partial JSON then reconnects and app emits a new stream. Android 13, app v2.4.3, ~12% of sessions. Ticket: https://acme.support/12345. Pasting trimmed logs below.

acme-mobile-dev: here are the client logs + stack:
```
SSE: event: message
data: {"id":"evt-9a3", "choices":[{"delta":"Hel"}]
# next line abrupt close - socket closed by remote

okhttp3.internal.http2.StreamResetException: stream was reset: CANCEL
```

jess: thanks. Do you have a minimal repro (curl or okhttp sample) and the stream id for affected sessions? Also: do you rotate auth tokens mid-stream?

acme-mobile-dev: repro curl attached - we append Authorization: Bearer <token> and then toggle network on device after ~1s: 
```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/chat?model=redwood-2"
# we see first data chunk then connection resets after our network toggle
```

jess: server ingest logs show: 
```
[1764509880] org=acme svc=streams session=evt-9a3 INFO: downstream chunk sent
[1764509881] org=acme svc=streams session=evt-9a3 WARN: client disconnected (read error: ECONNRESET)
```

rajesh: quick q — is this over HTTP/1.1 SSE or HTTP/2? OkHttp will sometimes tear down streams on network handoff if it can't migrate sockets. If it's HTTP/2 and the connection is torn, stream-level resets can happen.

acme-mobile-dev: OkHttp SSE (HTTP/1.1 longpoll-style SSE over TLS), not HTTP/2. They use OkHttp 4.10. No explicit token rotation mid-stream.

matt-platform: two common suspects: 1) client-side connection library behavior on network change (OkHttp may cancel on route change), 2) intermediary proxy/load-balancer idle timeouts or connection pool eviction. Can you confirm whether ACME runs through a corporate proxy or a mobile operator NAT? Also share any proxy logs.

deploy-bot: deploy redwood/streams-service@v1.27.2 completed at 1764509884 :rocket:

jess: checklist for triage:
- confirm client library (OkHttp) version and SSE wrapper behavior on route change
- capture a tcpdump at the time of the flip (device or edge) to see FIN/RESET pattern
- check LB and gateway idle/keepalive timeouts (ALB/GCLB/nginx) + connection reuse policy
- verify no token refresh/reauth race mid-stream
- see if payload is chunked and client discards incomplete frames

emily-support: ACME says they can repro in our test harness. I'll ask them to schedule a repro window tomorrow 10:00am PT. Can eng-runtime try reproducing locally with Pixel 6 + network link conditioner? @rajesh @matt-platform

rajesh: I'll spin up a Pixel 6 emulator + OkHttp harness and do WiFi->cell toggle + airplane-mode flip. If I can repro, I'll attach a flame graph. Also can we enable extended tracing for org=acme for the repro window (include headers and raw socket events) so we can correlate?

acme-mobile-dev: sample partial payload we see on client (note truncated):
```
data: {"id":"evt-9a3", "choices":[{"delta":"Hello, we"}, {"delta":"re trying to s"}
# stream cut here - missing closing brackets
```

jess: that truncation matches a mid-stream TCP RST. If we see RST then client library likely didn't retry the partial chunk and produced a new stream. We should decide expected behavior: should client concat partials after reconnect? Usually not — best to design prompts to be idempotent or resume via server checkpoints.

matt-platform: short mitigation recommendations to share with ACME:
- enable application-level keepalive pings every 15-30s (SSE comment ping or tiny data event)
- set LB/proxy keepalive to >60s and enable TCP keepalive on server sockets
- consider switching to an HTTP/2 or WebSocket streaming transport if the client environment expects network migrations

emily-support: OK I'll send that back to ACME and schedule the repro window. Also asking infra to temporarily enable extended traces for org=acme starting 1764509900 -> 1764510500 and to save raw socket captures. Tagging @rajesh for engineer access. :pray:

rajesh: got it — will try to reproduce at 10am PT. If I can trigger, I'll open an ENG issue with reproducer + guidance for a durable resume strategy.

emily-support: thanks team. I'll update ticket #12345 and add steps for ACME to gather tcpdump + SDK logs during the window.
